What does AI need to work in a business?
知识孤岛 —— 核心数据散落在文档、数据库和员工经验里，通用 AI 拿不到，也用不好。→ Cyano 把企业知识接入、清洗、建立带权限的索引。
资料分散 —— 产品资料、业务记录和操作经验分布在不同文档与系统中。→ 接入并整理资料，建立按权限检索的索引。
Knowledge silos — your critical data lives in documents, databases and people's heads. Generic AI can't reach it. → Cyano connects, cleans and indexes your knowledge with permissions built in.
Scattered sources — product information, business records and procedures live in different documents and systems. → Connect and organize these sources for retrieval with access controls.
上下文受限 —— 信息喂不全就会产生幻觉，复杂任务越做越偏。→ Cyano Core 在有限窗口内只装入最相关的信息。
信息取舍 —— 一次请求能容纳的信息有限，过多无关资料也会干扰回答。→ Cyano Core 根据当前任务选择相关资料与上下文。
Limited context — incomplete context breeds hallucinations and drift. → Cyano Core fits only the most relevant information into every request.
Context selection — each request has a size limit, and irrelevant material can distract from the question. → Cyano Core selects sources and context for the current task.
输出不可控 —— 同一个问题不同答案，企业不敢把它用在合同与财务流程上。→ 每个工作流都有校验规则、引用溯源和人工审核点。
结果核查 —— 生成内容可能有误，合同和财务等工作需要明确的审核程序。→ 在流程中加入规则校验、来源引用和人工审核。
Unpredictable output — same question, different answers. Not acceptable for contracts or finance. → Every workflow has validation rules, citations and human checkpoints.
Review requirements — generated content can be wrong, and work involving contracts or finances needs review. → Add validation rules, source citations and human approval to the workflow.
无法规模化 —— 靠个别员工的 Prompt 技巧只能救急，无法沉淀为组织能力。→ 我们把 SOP 固化为可复用、可审计的系统。
团队使用 —— 员工各自编写提示词，处理方法和结果难以统一。→ 按企业 SOP 设置操作步骤，保留执行记录，供团队重复使用。
No way to scale — individual prompting skills don't become company capability. → We turn your SOPs into reusable, auditable systems.
Team use — individually written prompts can produce inconsistent processes and results. → Define shared steps from your SOPs and retain execution records.

Why “Cyano”
Our services
Cyano 取自 cyan —— 青色，冷静、精确、清澈。我们的中文名“澜屿”，澜是流动的波澜，屿是海中的岛屿。企业的知识像一座座孤岛，散落在文档、系统和员工的经验里；我们做的，是让知识像波澜一样在岛屿之间流动起来，变成每天都能用上的能力。
Cyano（澜屿智创）提供企业 AI 定制开发、试点与托管服务。我们根据企业的资料和流程设计系统，并负责约定范围内的上线维护。

Cyano comes from cyan — calm, precise, clear. Our Chinese name, 澜屿 (Lán Yǔ), means “waves and islands.” Company knowledge sits on islands: in documents, in systems, in people's heads. Our job is to make it flow between them, like waves — and turn it into something your team uses every day.
Cyano provides custom enterprise AI development, pilots and managed services. We design systems around company sources and workflows, and maintain them within the agreed service scope.
